description: Source code implementing a TinySRP client for SRP authentication, including functions for client initialization, key generation, password processing, session key derivation, verification, and cleanup.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes a new SRP client session with user credentials and parameters, performing validation and setting up cryptographic context.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a public ephemeral value (A) for the SRP protocol based on a random secret.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Computes verifier values (p and v) from the password and salt, storing them in the client structure.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Derives the session key using server's public value and client parameters, performing SRP calculations.

methods.name: t_clientverify
methods.description: Verifies server response by comparing expected hash with provided response.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the client structure.
